name: mailkit-agent
description: Read IMAP and POP3 mailboxes and send confirmed email from local accounts with MailKit.

interface.shortDescription: Read mail and send with explicit confirmation
interface.longDescription: Configure non-secret accounts with a local credential CLI, test IMAP, POP3, and SMTP connections, browse folders, list, search, and read messages, save attachments into an isolated download root, and send email only after a two-stage user confirmation through a bundled MailKit MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Check whether the local email server plugin is healthy.
Test the connection for each of my email accounts.
List unread messages in my IMAP inbox.
Prepare a safe preview of an email I want to send and wait for my confirmation.
